method: Sets 01–19 condensed to 130–170-word passages and short options with unchanged keys, label types and reasoning chains. Independent reviewers saw passages and options only (scripts/blind-review.mjs export). Every key agreed; six items reworded after review were checked again blind (recheck files); label disagreements were settled by adopting the reviewer label where its reading was defensible, with notes rewritten to match.

D.resolution: option reworded as an unstated reason, because a set may not make every distractor a flat contradiction; a second blind check confirmed Not supported
